table_title: List the 16 US Chief Justices of the United States Supreme Court who have completed their tenure, from John Jay (first Chief Justice, 1789) through William Rehnquist (16th Chief Justice, tenure ended 2005), per Wikipedia's `Chief Justice of the United States` master article. Benchmark window scope: completed-tenure Chief Justices only — the current incumbent John Roberts (17th Chief Justice, took oath September 29, 2005, still serving as of 2026-05-18) is OUT of scope, mirroring the `nato_secretaries_general_birth_country_terms` instance's exclusion of incumbent Rutte. For each Chief Justice, give the Tenure Start Year (year the Chief Justice took the oath of office per master table — NOT Senate-confirmation year; e.g., Earl Warren confirmed 1953 but took oath March 1, 1954 → 1954), Tenure End Year (year tenure ended by death or retirement per master table), and Appointing President (US President who appointed the Chief Justice per master table).
db_analog: SELECT chief_justice_name, tenure_start_year, tenure_end_year, appointing_president FROM us_chief_justices WHERE tenure_status = 'completed' ORDER BY tenure_start_year ASC
temporal_note: Wikipedia `Chief Justice of the United States` master article, accessed 2026-05-18. Universe is the closed canonical 16-entry list of US Chief Justices with completed tenure (John Jay 1789 → William Rehnquist tenure end 2005). Benchmark window: completed-tenure Chief Justices only — incumbent John Roberts (took oath September 29, 2005, still serving 2026-05-18) is OUT of scope per the cycle-1 audit-confirmed scope clause; mirror precedent `nato_secretaries_general_birth_country_terms` (Rutte excluded as incumbent). source_count = 1 registered (master article supplies all 4 cells: Chief Justice name + Tenure Start Year + Tenure End Year + Appointing President via the consolidated office-holders table per cycle-1 audit's required staging edit #1). 16 per-Chief-Justice Wikipedia articles consulted as validation cross-checks during curation but per the artifact contract do NOT count toward source_count and are NOT registered in source_urls — they live in curation.json::source_coverage_notes::validation_cross_checks as provenance prose per the periodic_table_groups + decade_volcanoes + phanerozoic_periods + global_200_tropical_moist_broadleaf_forest_ecoregions_by_realm precedents. temporal_sensitivity = medium — the Chief Justice office adds a new completed tenure only when an incumbent retires/dies; currently stable since 2005 (Rehnquist tenure end); Roberts is active incumbent. When Roberts' tenure eventually ends, universe extends from 16 → 17. Cycle-1 audit staging edits applied: (1) source_count corrected from 17 → 1 (master only; per-Justice articles validation prose per cycle-1 audit); (2) Earl Warren Tenure Start Year corrected from 1953 → 1954 per master's oath-of-office date convention (Warren confirmed 1953 but took oath March 1, 1954). Per-row cells: Chief Justice name verbatim from master table row labels (e.g., 'Roger B. Taney' with middle initial; 'Edward Douglass White'; 'Harlan F. Stone'; 'Fred M. Vinson'; 'Warren E. Burger'); Tenure Start Year per oath-of-office date in master; Tenure End Year per death-or-retirement date in master; Appointing President per master's appointer column (e.g., Edward Douglass White appointed by William Howard Taft via promotion from Associate Justice).

Taney (Dred Scott 1857), Earl Warren (Brown v. Board 1954, civil-rights revolution), William Rehnquist (1986-2005 conservative court), Warren E. Burger (Roe v. Stone (1941-1946 promoted Roosevelt-era), Fred M. Vinson (1946-1953 Truman-appointed).
